preservedAttemptInterpretation: Local origin with SDK observation produced provider error 150. Public SDK-observed attempts did not satisfy the state/progress assertions; no cause assigned. Read-only real-media observation without an added SDK proves public playback separately. An Escape attempt from inside the cross-origin frame did not close it. A follow-up initially clicked Search before remount completed; the final runner waits for the actual row and preserves the same close/Back assertions.
limitations: The exact song still does not play as direct HTMLAudio. Official mode is an explicit visible video workaround, not complete APK parity.
Official mode does not integrate Pletina queue, listening history, downloads, sleep timer or automatic next song. It uses YouTube controls and never resumes the old audio automatically.
No background, screen-off or offline playback guarantee for official mode. Human Xiaomi reply confirms playback/Close only; physical iPhone and complete device protocols remain pending.
YouTube can consume Escape while focus is inside its cross-origin frame; use the visible Close control or Back. Browser-history Back was tested, not a physical Android button.
No claim that every restricted, removed, private or unavailable YouTube recording will play. Matching and provider restrictions remain.
Android Auto and CarPlay remain unverified/unsupported as previously documented.
